articles.title: 8th Pay Commission: JPMorgan estimates 1.83 fitment factor, ₹7.2 lakh crore payout, including ₹4 lakh crore arrears
articles.summary: The 8th Pay Commission could deliver a 14% gross salary increase with a 1.83 fitment factor, according to JPMorgan. Its estimates project a ₹7.2 lakh crore payout, including substantial arrears, across FY28 and FY29.

articles.title: 8th Pay Commission's Ladakh visit puts salary hike and pay parity demands in focus; seeks replies to 33 queries

articles.title: 8th Pay Commission: Can employees expect an interim report before final recommendations? Expert explains
articles.summary: The 8th Pay Commission can submit interim reports before its final recommendations, potentially allowing early consideration of selected pay matters. However, central government employees and pensioners are not guaranteed interim relief, salary hikes or arrears.

articles.title: 8th Pay Commission implementation: Why a delay until 2028 could prove costly for the Centre's finances
articles.summary: Delaying the 8th Pay Commission until 2028 could offer temporary relief to government finances but increase salary arrears. Deutsche Bank estimates the pay revision could add at least ₹3 lakh crore to the Centre's expenditure.

articles.title: The Wealthy Barber retirement: David Chilton's final money lessons on saving, debt and investing; what's next for him?
articles.summary: Financial author David Chilton says he plans to retire to spend more time with family and friends.
